title: Mac Health Check (4.0.0)
description: Latest status for Macs: macOS version, CrowdStrike Falcon, BeyondTrust EPM and Cisco Umbrella

viz_VjliKlrl.description: Latest status for the macOS version check

options.query:
index=replace_with_your_index_prefix sourcetype=macHealthCheck
| rename metadata.serialNumber AS serialNumber
| rename systemInfo.computerName AS computerName
| rename metadata.hostname AS hostname
| rename metadata.timestamp AS reportTimestamp
| rename summary.overallStatus AS reportedOverallStatus
| rename systemInfo.macOSBuild AS macOSBuild
| rename checks{}.key AS checkKey
| rename checks{}.status AS checkStatus
| eval deviceKey=coalesce(serialNumber, computerName, hostname)
| where isnotnull(deviceKey)
| sort 0 - _time
| dedup deviceKey
| eval macOSVersionStatus=if(isnull(macOSBuild) OR NOT match(macOSBuild, "[A-Za-z]$"), mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^macos_version$")), null())
| eval crowdstrikeFalconStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^crowdstrike_falcon$"))
| eval beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^beyondtrust_privilege_management$"))
| eval ciscoUmbrellaStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^cisco_umbrella$"))
| fillnull value="unknown" macOSVersionStatus crowdstrikeFalconStatus beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus ciscoUmbrellaStatus
| eval overallStatus=case(
    macOSVersionStatus="fail" OR crowdstrikeFalconStatus="fail" OR beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus="fail" OR ciscoUmbrellaStatus="fail", "fail",
    macOSVersionStatus="warning" OR crowdstrikeFalconStatus="warning" OR beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus="warning" OR ciscoUmbrellaStatus="warning", "warning",
    true(), "healthy"
  )
| eval reportedOverallStatus=coalesce(reportedOverallStatus, "unknown")
| eval reportEpoch=coalesce(
    strptime(replace(reportTimestamp,"([+-]\d\d):(\d\d)$","\1\2"), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"),
    _time
  )
| eval latestReport=strftime(reportEpoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
| where isnull(macOSBuild) OR NOT match(macOSBuild, "[A-Za-z]$")
| where macOSVersionStatus="$row.status.value$"
| eval matchingChecks="macOS Version"
| sort 0 deviceKey
| rename latestReport as "Latest Report"
         overallStatus as "Computed Overall"
         reportedOverallStatus as "Reported Overall"
         matchingChecks as "Matching Check"
         serialNumber as "Serial Number"
         computerName as "Computer Name"
         hostname as "Hostname"
         macOSBuild as "macOS Build"
         macOSVersionStatus as "macOS Version"
         crowdstrikeFalconStatus as "CrowdStrike Falcon"
         beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus as "BeyondTrust PM"
         ciscoUmbrellaStatus as "Cisco Umbrella"
| table "Latest Report" "Computed Overall" "Reported Overall" "Matching Check" "Serial Number" "Computer Name" "Hostname" "macOS Build" "macOS Version" "CrowdStrike Falcon" "BeyondTrust PM" "Cisco Umbrella"

options.query:
index=replace_with_your_index_prefix sourcetype=macHealthCheck
| rename metadata.serialNumber AS serialNumber
| rename systemInfo.computerName AS computerName
| rename metadata.hostname AS hostname
| rename metadata.timestamp AS reportTimestamp
| rename summary.overallStatus AS reportedOverallStatus
| rename systemInfo.macOSBuild AS macOSBuild
| rename checks{}.key AS checkKey
| rename checks{}.status AS checkStatus
| eval deviceKey=coalesce(serialNumber, computerName, hostname)
| where isnotnull(deviceKey)
| sort 0 - _time
| dedup deviceKey
| eval macOSVersionStatus=if(isnull(macOSBuild) OR NOT match(macOSBuild, "[A-Za-z]$"), mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^macos_version$")), null())
| eval crowdstrikeFalconStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^crowdstrike_falcon$"))
| eval beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^beyondtrust_privilege_management$"))
| eval ciscoUmbrellaStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^cisco_umbrella$"))
| fillnull value="unknown" macOSVersionStatus crowdstrikeFalconStatus beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus ciscoUmbrellaStatus
| eval status=crowdstrikeFalconStatus
| stats count by status
| eventstats sum(count) as total
| eval pct=round((count/total)*100, 1)
| eval sortOrder=case(
    status="fail", 1,
    status="warning", 2,
    status="healthy", 3,
    status="unknown", 4,
    true(), 5
  )
| sort sortOrder
| fields status count pct

| rename metadata.serialNumber AS serialNumber
| rename systemInfo.computerName AS computerName
| rename metadata.hostname AS hostname
| rename metadata.timestamp AS reportTimestamp
| rename summary.overallStatus AS reportedOverallStatus
| rename systemInfo.macOSBuild AS macOSBuild
| rename checks{}.key AS checkKey
| rename checks{}.status AS checkStatus
| eval deviceKey=coalesce(serialNumber, computerName, hostname)
| where isnotnull(deviceKey)
| sort 0 - _time
| dedup deviceKey
| eval macOSVersionStatus=if(isnull(macOSBuild) OR NOT match(macOSBuild, "[A-Za-z]$"), mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^macos_version$")), null())
| eval crowdstrikeFalconStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^crowdstrike_falcon$"))
| eval beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^beyondtrust_privilege_management$"))
| eval ciscoUmbrellaStatus=mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^cisco_umbrella$"))
| fillnull value="unknown" macOSVersionStatus crowdstrikeFalconStatus beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus ciscoUmbrellaStatus
| eval overallStatus=case(
    macOSVersionStatus="fail" OR crowdstrikeFalconStatus="fail" OR beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus="fail" OR ciscoUmbrellaStatus="fail", "fail",
    macOSVersionStatus="warning" OR crowdstrikeFalconStatus="warning" OR beyondtrustPrivilegeManagementStatus="warning" OR ciscoUmbrellaStatus="warning", "warning",
    true(), "healthy"
  )
| stats count by overallStatus
| eventstats sum(count) as total
| eval pct=round((count/total)*100, 1)
| eval sortOrder=case(
    overallStatus="fail", 1,
    overallStatus="warning", 2,
    overallStatus="healthy", 3,
    true(), 4
  )
| sort sortOrder
| fields overallStatus count pct

index=replace_with_your_index_prefix sourcetype=macHealthCheck
| rename metadata.serialNumber AS serialNumber
| rename systemInfo.computerName AS computerName
| rename metadata.hostname AS hostname
| rename metadata.timestamp AS reportTimestamp
| rename summary.overallStatus AS reportedOverallStatus
| rename systemInfo.macOSBuild AS macOSBuild
| rename checks{}.key AS checkKey
| rename checks{}.status AS checkStatus
| eval deviceKey=coalesce(serialNumber, computerName, hostname)
| where isnotnull(deviceKey)
| sort 0 - _time
| dedup deviceKey
| eval status=coalesce(mvindex(checkStatus, mvfind(checkKey, "^filevault_encryption$")), "unknown")
| stats count as deviceCount sum(eval(status="healthy")) as healthyCount
| eval healthyPct=if(deviceCount>0, round((healthyCount/deviceCount)*100, 1), 0)
| fields healthyPct
